# Lost your job-based health insurance: is COBRA or a marketplace plan cheaper?

> Enter your COBRA premium and a marketplace quote and see the total cost of each over the months you need coverage, at five levels of medical care, with the break-even point and your election and special-enrollment deadlines. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
